overview_description.description:
Uniquely positioned as a new age matrimony platform, Betterhalf envisions to build a super app of Indian matrimony and full stack wedding services as company's growth pillars. 

Founded by Pawan Gupta and Rahul Namdev, Betterhalf recently raised Series A backed by FinSight Ventures (Ex Bumble investor)  & other marquee investors including Mike Krieger, Co-founder of Instagram; Arash Ferdowsi, Co-Founder of Dropbox and many others.
